Comment: Pause Waiter - Save pause token to DynamoDB and exit (parent waits for callback)

Save_Pause_Token.Comment: Save the task token, mark the row waiting_paused and put it in the attention index (paused#, due in 10 minutes). The sweeper releases the task if its run is no longer paused: a resume can miss a token written while it ran (ADR #130 §8). run_task removes the entry when it continues.

Arguments.UpdateExpression: SET #s = :status, pause_token = :token, paused_at = :paused_at, attention = :attention, attention_at = :due, attempts = :zero

Catch.Comment: Without a saved token nothing can release the task, and it would run when its 12-hour pause heartbeat ran out, paused or not. Fail its pause wait instead, with the cause.

Fail_Pause_Wait.Comment: run_task's pause wait fails with CoordinationError (ADR #130 §9, B-P4): run_task fails, and the wrapper's failure handler marks the task failed with this cause, visible in the console.

Arguments.Cause: {% $substring('The task could not enter its pause wait, so it did not start; restart it once the cause is fixed: ' & $string($states.input.save_error), 0, 32768) %}
